notes: Authored dungeons, set 1 of 2 (Plan 6 D5). Each is drawn on one dungeon map image (the path is relative to ~/dnd5e and listed in assets.manifest.txt) and delved room by room in order. Coordinates are [x, y] fractions of the image, read off downscaled copies; room texts and their situations follow what the map shows there, in our own words. Room situations live in dungeon-rooms-1.json. Dark rooms (Plan 7 Track D, combat design §7b): `dark` marks rooms unlit on the map and in their texts (caves, crypts, sewers, mine galleries, deep halls); about 60% of all dungeons have one and about 20% are mostly dark (src/content/dark.test.ts).

entries.name: Cutpurse Hollow
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_dungeon/_dice grimorium maps/Bandit-Den-Gridded-22x33-Map1.jpg
entries.summary: A stream cave where a bandit crew has built plank halls to hide its loot.

rooms.name: The Stream Passage
rooms.text: An underground stream runs fast along the west wall and out of the cave mouth. The crew's path follows its bank, under a rocky ledge.

rooms.name: The Storehouse
rooms.text: A plank-floored store crowded with crates, kegs and small iron cages. A tray of cheap rings and buttons waits on a crate to be sorted.

rooms.name: The Sorting Floor
rooms.text: Sacks of stolen grain and cloth lie heaped on a plank floor. Gnawed bones are piled in one corner, an iron cage stands by the wall, and a trapdoor gapes open.

rooms.name: The Bunk Hall
rooms.text: Bedrolls lie in a row down a long plank hall. A table by the door holds a knife, a few coins and a half-eaten supper.

rooms.name: The Captain's Table
rooms.text: A table spread with food, coin and a stolen map, kegs stacked along the wall. Behind it a webbed cleft runs off into the rock.

hoard.text: The captain's strongbox under the table, and the best of the season's take.

entries.name: Weaver's Hollow
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_cave : lava/300dpi_cave_spider_day_grid.jpg
entries.summary: Red-walled caverns under the roots, strung wall to wall with web.

rooms.name: The Web Throat
rooms.text: A narrow passage climbs into the hill, its walls already furred with web. Strands cross it at knee and neck height.

rooms.name: The Cocoon Cavern
rooms.text: A wide cavern hung with sheets of web. Wrapped bundles dangle among the strands, and a clutch of pale eggs sits by the west wall.

rooms.name: The Orb-Web Chamber
rooms.text: A round chamber at the end of a thin tunnel, filled wall to wall by one great wheel of web. Something is caught at its hub.

rooms.name: The Egg Gallery
rooms.text: A long cavern whose west end is heaped with hundreds of pale eggs. Bundled shapes lie in a hollow by the east wall.

rooms.name: The Brood Mother's Funnel
rooms.text: The largest cavern. Its north wall is drawn into a thick white funnel of web around a black hole in the rock.

hoard.text: Coins, buckles and rings from the brood's victims, picked out of the old cocoons in the funnel.

entries.name: the Axe Temple
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_dungeon/theros crypt.jpg
entries.summary: A forgotten war god's temple under the turf, taken over by a horned cult.

rooms.name: The Pillared Vestibule
rooms.text: Four squat black pillars hold up a low hall. A great rune is cut into the floor between them, and rubble spills from the corners.

rooms.name: The Gallery of Champions
rooms.text: A long gallery lined with six gilded statues of armoured champions on plinths, facing inward.

rooms.name: The Scorched Tomb
rooms.text: An eight-sided tomb blackened by old fire. Two of its stone coffins lie open, a skeleton still stretched out in each.

rooms.name: The Horned Shrine
rooms.text: An oval chamber where a horned red idol squats on an altar above a blood-red fur. Fresh offerings lie before it.

rooms.name: The Hall of the Axe
rooms.text: A vast eight-sided hall. A double-headed axe of pale blue light, long as three men, is set into the floor, and it hums.

hoard.text: The tithes heaped below the axe: the old god's offerings and the cult's stolen coin.

entries.name: the Sun-Drowned Temple
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_desert/temple of the sun.jpeg
entries.summary: A sun temple swallowed by the dunes, its halls half full of sand, where a priest-king still lies in gold.

rooms.name: The Round Landing
rooms.text: The stair comes up into a round chamber. A shallow stone bowl sits in the middle, ringed with pebbles, its fire long dead.

rooms.name: The Drift Hall
rooms.text: Sand has poured in through a broken roof and drifted waist-deep across this hall.

rooms.name: The Sunstone Court
rooms.text: Four pillars stand round a star-shaped stone on a pedestal. It glows with light from nowhere.

rooms.name: The Altar of Twin Flames
rooms.text: A long hall ends at an altar between two braziers that still burn. A blue crystal lies across the altar.

rooms.name: The Golden Rotunda
rooms.text: A round tomb ringed by eight pillars. In its heart a golden coffin stands upright among jars and lamps.

hoard.text: The priest-king's grave goods: gold masks, jars of scented oil and a sun disc of beaten gold.

entries.name: Gnawbone Warren
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_cave : lava/cavern with chasm.jpeg
entries.summary: A maze of caves round a bottomless chasm, held by a gnoll pack and its bone-crowned matriarch.

rooms.name: The Roasting Cave
rooms.text: A side cave lit by a cookfire. Something large turns on a spit, and crates and sacks are stacked round the walls.

rooms.name: The Plank Walks
rooms.text: A sunken pit of black, sucking mud, crossed by a rickety lattice of planks lashed together on posts.

rooms.name: The Tent Camp
rooms.text: A firelit hollow ringed by hide tents, crates and sacks. Bones lie everywhere.

rooms.name: The Chasm
rooms.text: A black crack splits the cave floor from wall to wall, too deep for any torch to find the bottom.

rooms.name: The Bone-Lidded Coffin
rooms.text: At the end of the far gallery stands a stone coffin, its lid carved with a skull and crossed bones. The pack's matriarch has made it her throne.

hoard.text: The coffin holds the pack's plunder: rings, coins and trinkets torn from a season of travellers.

entries.name: the Green Undercroft
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_dungeon/sewer temple toxic.jpg
entries.summary: A temple-sized sewer under a dead town, where poisoned sludge pours out of a sealed door.

rooms.name: The Drain Hall
rooms.text: A cross-shaped chamber with an iron drain grate at its heart. Four pipes in the walls leak a green, stinging fume.

rooms.name: The Vat Room
rooms.text: Four round vats steam green in a long room, and a red-banded hatch is set in the wall between them.

rooms.name: The Spout Gallery
rooms.text: A many-sided chamber where stone gargoyle heads spit into a sludge channel, and pipes leak fumes across the floor.

rooms.name: The Sinkhole
rooms.text: The sludge channel loops round a hollow block. In one bend the floor has fallen in, and the green flood pours into a hole ringed with rubble.

rooms.name: The Sludge Falls
rooms.text: Sludge pours down a chute from the town above, over a red-barred door. Six pipe-mouths in the side halls breathe green fog.

hoard.text: Behind the red-barred door: the cult's coffers and the dead town's long-lost treasury.

entries.name: the Rime Heart
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_arctic/temple of the frozen heart.jpeg
entries.summary: An ice-locked temple in the high passes, built round a heart that will not thaw.

rooms.name: The Frozen Mere
rooms.text: A lake frozen hard below the temple's stair, with a path cut across it and broken ice heaped along the rocky shores.

rooms.name: The Corner Tower
rooms.text: A round tower stands at the corner of the stair, its doorway choked with drifted snow and its floor scattered with gnawed bones.

rooms.name: The Hall of Breathing Heads
rooms.text: Iron grates bridge black, half-frozen pools. Huge stone heads set in the walls breathe out a freezing mist over the water.

rooms.name: The Drain Galleries
rooms.text: Narrow grated halls run off the main hall, where meltwater drains away through pipes in the end walls.

rooms.name: The Chained Heart
rooms.text: Up a short stair, a domed apse: a blue heart glows in a chained casket, held up by two clawed stone guardians.

hoard.text: The offerings frozen into the ice round the casket: gems, silver and old blades.

entries.name: the Jackal King's Tomb
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_desert/pharaohs tomb.jpg
entries.summary: A river-side royal tomb behind an avenue of ram-headed sphinxes, watched by a colossal jackal god.

rooms.name: The Avenue of Rams
rooms.text: A paved road climbs from the river landing between two rows of ram-headed sphinxes to a pair of great sphinxes at the doors.

rooms.name: The Hall of Pools
rooms.text: A hall of tall columns with long green pools on either side, still and thick with weed.

rooms.name: The Scarab Hall
rooms.text: A wide hall whose floor is a great painted scarab under a winged sun, flanked by round pillars.

rooms.name: The Jackal Throne
rooms.text: A colossal statue of a jackal-headed god sits enthroned, a staff across its knees, before the doors of the burial chamber.

rooms.name: The Burial Chamber
rooms.text: A low chamber crowded with urns, scrolls and braziers. The king's gilded coffin stands upright under a wall of carved signs, with lesser coffins at either end.

hoard.text: The king's burial treasure: gold, lapis, scented oils and his jewelled death masks.

entries.name: the Lich's Gauntlet
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_epic/gauntlet of the lich.jpeg
entries.summary: A proving ground under a hill, built by a lich to test those who would serve it. Few come out.

rooms.name: The Green Pool
rooms.text: The way in is a swim: you come up through cold water into a cavern lit green from below. Spikes of crystal jut from the walls under the water line.

rooms.name: The Barred Hall
rooms.text: A corridor of rusted iron bars with a locked gate across its middle. On the left, four coffins before urns of cold blue fire; on the right, a heap of broken coffins and bones.

rooms.name: The Roaring Cave
rooms.text: A cave fanged with stalactites and stalagmites. In its far corner a cleft glows white-hot and roars like a furnace.

rooms.name: The Spiked Passage
rooms.text: West of the cave, a short passage crossed by two bands of iron spikes set in slots in the floor, with bones between them.

rooms.name: The Violet Glyph
rooms.text: A hall turning south, its far corner a quarter-circle of glowing violet runes round a body wrapped in grave-cloth.

rooms.name: The Hall of Braziers
rooms.text: A wide hall lit by six braziers on iron stands, three down each wall, burning with a steady yellow flame.

rooms.name: The Frost Hall
rooms.text: A pillared hall gone white with frost. Lines of cold light run across the floor from pillar to pillar.

rooms.name: The Lightning Vault
rooms.text: A square vault of rose-coloured stone, cracked across with veins of violet lightning that crawl over the floor. A long stone bier lies in the middle.

hoard.text: Hidden in the bier: what the lich's failed candidates carried in, and the champion's own arms.

entries.name: Drakescale Forge
entries.map: tiles and battle maps/dungeon maps/_cave : lava/lava drakescale peak.jpg
entries.summary: A forge-camp inside a volcano, where a red dragon's servants smelt its tithe beside a lake of fire.

rooms.name: The Thrall Camp
rooms.text: Past two horned statues at the edge of a lava river lies a camp of shacks on scorched ground, round a smoky campfire.

rooms.name: The Tithe Hall
rooms.text: A long timber hall where tables are heaped with coin, bones and barrels: the dragon's tithe, counted and stacked.

rooms.name: The Brood Pit
rooms.text: A sunken dirt floor pocked with round scorched hollows and scattered bones. Pale eggs lie heaped in two of its corners.

rooms.name: The Drake Pens
rooms.text: A timber stockade holds a red drake on a heavy chain, with a water trough beside it.

rooms.name: The East Furnace
rooms.text: A second furnace, its great vat joined by long poles to a line of smaller crucibles along the wall, among barrels of fuel and slag.

rooms.name: The Smelting Floor
rooms.text: Great copper vats sit on roaring furnaces, stirred by long poles on cranks. Barrels of ore and slag crowd the floor.

rooms.name: The Tithe Heap
rooms.text: A side cave knee-deep in coin, where blackened shapes of men stand half sunk in the gold. A clerk's desk heaped with ledgers stands at its mouth.

rooms.name: The Lava Bridges
rooms.text: Two arched stone bridges cross a lake of molten rock to a dark island. Bones lie scattered on the far shore.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Isle
rooms.text: A dark island in the lava, its floor inlaid with a great dragon. Gold is heaped in caves on either side of the lake.

hoard.text: The dragon's hoard, spilling out of the two gold caves above the lava lake.
